notes: 1,332 MW pumped storage (4x333 MW) on the KwaZulu-Natal/Free State border; CMI-JV civil works paid R14.96bn; Voith electro-mechanical about EUR 140m; Eskom owner-operator; units in commercial operation June 2016 to January 2017

title: Libreville airport bypass road construction
notes: About 6 km of 2x2 and 2x3 lanes at Alibandeng-Okala linking Libreville to Akanda; built by AFCONS of India; commissioned 29 August 2024

title: Bertil Harding Highway phases 1-2 construction
notes: 22 km dual carriageway Airport Junction to Sting Corner with 3 overpasses; built by Arezki Group; US$96m jointly funded by IsDB, Kuwait Fund, BADEA and The Gambia; commissioned 22 February 2025; Phase 3 US$40m IsDB loan

title: Danzi solar park construction
notes: 25 MWp solar with battery storage at Danzi village 18 km from Bangui; 47,000 panels on 70 ha; built by Shanxi Construction; World Bank IDA grant; 37bn CFA; inaugurated 17 November 2023

title: Red Sea Power wind farm development and operation
notes: 60 MW wind farm near Lake Goubet; 17 Siemens 3.4 MW turbines; AFC 51%, FMO 19.5%, CIO 19.5%, GHIH 10%; CFM US$25m; Djibouti's first IPP; inaugurated 10 September 2023

title: Ile de Romainville solar park construction
notes: 5 MWp solar with 3.3 MWh storage on Ile de Romainville; 15,000 panels; developed by Masdar with PUC; ADFD US$8.5m loan plus PUC US$1.7m equity; commissioned April 2021; inaugurated 12 December 2022

title: Ha Mpiti-Sehlabathebe road upgrade construction
financing_source: Export-Import Bank of China; Government of Lesotho
notes: 91 km upgraded from gravel to asphalt; Qinjian Group (CNQC) appointed 2018; China Exim concessional loan (RMB 700m per AidData); practical completion March 2024

title: Mmamashia water treatment plant expansion
financing_source: Government of Botswana; Water Utilities Corporation
notes: Expansion to 110 ML/d new capacity, combined 284 ML/d with existing plant and Masama wellfields; Khato Civils JV with South Zambezi; commissioned 22 October 2024

title: Maya-Maya airport terminal construction
notes: Two terminal modules totalling 44,500 m2 with 7 air bridges; built by Weitec (Weihai); second module inaugurated 5 February 2014; China Exim low-interest loan

title: Noor Chad solar plant development, construction and operation
notes: 50 MW PV with 5 MWh BESS at Djermaya, N'Djamena; developed, built and operated by Abu Dhabi-based GSU under a 20-year operating contract; inaugurated 27 September 2025

title: King Mswati III International Airport construction
notes: Stefanutti Stocks built terminal, cargo, control tower, fire station, fuel farm and VVIP terminal (JV with Inyatsi); 3.6 km runway; airport opened 7 March 2014; total cost about US$150m

title: Arsenal 14 MWp solar plant construction
notes: 14 MWp / 14 MWac PV at Arsenal; awarded through CEB 2021 tender; GreenYellow developed, financed and built; 20 GWh/yr; inaugurated 8 February 2024
